name: Example: Gold Board
author: byo-pop examples
description: Jewel Quest's goal: every cell a match clears turns gold, and the level ends when the whole board is gold. The bar fills as the gold spreads, or shows the time left when the level has a limit (Timed), and seconds left over earn points. With no moves the board refills. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Blasts gild too
settings.help: With flame or lightning gems from another mod: the cells a blast clears turn gold as well.

settings.label: Points a second left
settings.help: When a timed level is all gold, each second left earns this many points, times the multiplier.

settings.label: Time limit in Normal
settings.help: Off: Normal games have all the time they need. On: as Timed, with the times below.

settings.label: Each level adds (seconds)
settings.help: Below zero, every level has less time.
